mapper.select: select rpi.PROD_ID as prodId, rpi.PROD_RE prodRe, rpi.PROD_NAME prodName, rpi.PROD_ABBR prodAbbr, rpi.RAISE_MIN raiseMin, rpi.RAISE_MAX raiseMax, DATE_FORMAT(rpi.RAISE_STRDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') raiseStrdate, DATE_FORMAT(rpi.RAISE_ENDDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') raiseEnddate, rpi.RAISE_CCY raiseCcy, DATE_FORMAT(rpi.SET_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') setDate, DATE_FORMAT(rpi.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') vdate, rpi.FIRST_OPEN_DAY firstOpenDay, DATE_FORMAT(rpi.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as mdate, DATE_FORMAT(rpi.ACT_MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as actMdate, rpi.TERM as term, rpi.WINDUP_DATE as windupDate, rpi.ISSUE_MODE as issueMode, rpi.PROFIT_TYPE as profitType, rpi.PROD_TYPE as prodType, rpi.ISSUE_STATUS as issueStatus, rpi.RAISE_TYPE as raiseType, rpi.RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel from REP_PROD_INFO rpi where rpi.STATUS='E' and rpi.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rpi.p_prod_id is null

select rcr.CHECK_ID as checkId,rcr.REP_ID as repId,rcr.CHECK_FOR as checkFor,rcr.ID as id, rc.QUERY_SCOPE as queryScope,rc.QUERY_TYPE as queryType,rc.BASE_DATA_TYPE as baseDataType, rc.QUERY_CONTEN_DESCR as queryContenDescr,rc.QUERY_CONTEN as queryConten, rc.QUERY_PARAM as queryParam,rc.DATA_TYPE as dataType,rc.PARAM_TYPE as paramType, rc.PARAM_VALUE1 as paramValue1,rc.PARAM_VALUE2 as paramValue2 from REP_CHECK_RELATION rcr inner join REP_CHECK rc on rcr.CHECK_ID=rc.CHECK_ID and rc.STATUS='E' where rcr.STATUS='E' and rcr.REP_ID=#{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rcr.CHECK_FOR=#{checkFor,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
